meta.title: Surface Tension Converter — Convert Newton/meter and More
meta.description: Free surface tension converter for 4+ units including Newton/meter, Millinewton/meter, Dyne/centimeter. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: N/m, dyn/cm, lbf/in. Convert between 4 surface tension units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for surface tension in this tool is **Nm**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most surface tension conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Newton/meter | N/m |
| Millinewton/meter | mN/m |
| Dyne/centimeter | dyn/cm |
| Pound-force/inch | lbf/in |
content.use_cases:
- Recipe scaling and bartending where measures span metric and imperial.
- Fuel economy comparisons across regions.
- Lab dosing and reagent prep across mL, L, and US/UK units.
- Aquarium, pool, and tank capacity calculations.
- Shipping fluid product specs across markets.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this surface tension converter?
**A:** It uses 4 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Newton/meter (N/m), Millinewton/meter (mN/m), Dyne/centimeter (dyn/cm), Pound-force/inch (lbf/in).
